_comment: 🔣️ Single source of truth for taxonomy vocabulary + the repo-wide package discovery contract, consumed by 🟦️discovery.ts (TS side: registry script, root policy script) and — plain JSON, no TS-only constructs — by a future Rust build.rs codegen step in the plugin SDK testkit. Two independently hand-maintained copies of this vocabulary used to live in framework/os/plugin/registry script.ts (TAXONOMY_ARTIFACT_COMPONENTS/TAXONOMY_WINDOW_CHILDREN) and root script.ts (POLICY_ARTIFACT_COMPONENT_DIRS/POLICY_WINDOW_CHILD_DIRS/POLICY_TAXONOMY_LEAF_PARENT_DIRS); this file replaces them (M3/M4 of the mechanism wave switch those consumers over). See master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE and mechanism tickets 26/08/05/TAXONOMY-VOCABULARY-AND-PACKAGE-DISCOVERY-CONTRACT, 26/08/05/UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE, 26/08/06/MECHANISM-VOCABULARY-AND-DISCOVERY-LIBRARY.
_engineListComment: ⚙️ The ⚙️engine disagreement, resolved by keeping TWO explicitly separate lists that must never be merged: artifactComponentDirs is the COMPLETENESS set (every 🗿️artifacts/<a>/ must carry all of them as a leaf — what registry's validateTaxonomyTree checks); artifactChildDirs is the STRUCTURAL set (every dir that may appear as a child of an artifact — what root script's POLICY_ARTIFACT_COMPONENT_DIRS checks). ⚙️engine is structural-but-not-required, which is exactly why the two hand-maintained copies disagreed (5 vs 6 entries). artifactChildDirs is a superset of artifactComponentDirs; validateTaxonomy() in 🟦️discovery.ts enforces that invariant.
_treePurityComment: 🌳️ SHAPE V2 (26/08/05/SHAPE-V2-TREE-PURITY-BROADCAST, user directive): inside an owner's domain tree only three things may exist — a per-language leaf file (taxonomyLeafFilenames / ecosystems.<lang>.leafFilename, always `<prefix>component.<ext>`), the packagesDirName folder, and plain <component> folders. entryLocation="packages" means the entry file lives at <owner>/📦️packages/<lang>/<entry> (three-level shape: <owner>/📦️packages/<lang>/🎯️targets/<target>/<entry>) — 📦️packages holds ONLY packaging code (packagingFileNames/packagingFileSuffixes + the entry file), never data. rootDataDirNames/rootDataFileNames/rootDocFileNames are valid ONLY at the owner root. A sibling variant source file (old 🦀️config.rs / 🦀️terminology.rs / 🦀️wasm.rs / any 🦀️<topic>.rs beside a component.rs) is non-compliant under V2 and folds into its own <folder>/component.<ext> — same module content, only the #[path]/import wiring changes.
_areaStateComment: 🗺️ areas maps an area root to one of areaStates, replacing the registry script's LEGACY_LAYOUT_TOLERANT boolean with per-area granularity. It is a DECLARED value (an area graduates deliberately); per-owner/per-package maturity is DERIVED from disk instead — see migratedMarker and packageMaturityStates, never a hand-maintained package list. NOTE for 26/08/05/UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE: root script.ts's policyTaxonomyBarrelShapeBreaches compares against the area value "taxonomy", which predates this enum — the equivalent state here is "clean"; validateTaxonomy() rejects any area value outside areaStates so the mismatch surfaces instead of silently making that rule vacuous.

rustEntryPathRules._comment: 🦀️ #[path] resolution is CUMULATIVE: every nested `pub mod X { … }` resolves its own #[path] against its immediately enclosing scope's ALREADY-RESOLVED dir, and `#[path = "."]` means "keep the enclosing base". Under entryLocation="packages" the entry file sits entryDirFromOwner deep, so the owner tree is leafPathPrefix away. TWO conventions are valid and both appear in the repo today (confirmed by real compiles: 🏛️architect/📸️remodel/🖍️draw use leaf-prefixed, 🖨️raster uses once-reset) — a validator must model the base stack, not do a flat join.
